title.narrative: Comprehensive Socioeconomic Urban Development Project in Viet Tri, Hung Yen and Dong Dang

description.narrative: The proposed Project will address critical urban development issues of Viet Tri, Hung Yen, and Dong Dang in northern Viet Nam along the North-South economic corridor (NSEC), in contributing to the transformation of the NSEC from transport corridor into full-fledged economic corridor and in complementing Hanoi as alternative growth centers.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Improved urban infrastructure and municipal services in Viet Tri, Hung Yen, and Dong Dang

6,000 households served by wastewater treatment (2016) in Hung Yen Progress/Status: Wastewater treatment system being constructed, to complete by end 2018. Data Source: City annual reports and project completion report Baseline value: 0

About 800 households benefit from reduced incidence of flooding in 2016 in Dong Dang Progress/Status: About 900 households benefit from reduced flooding impacts in Dong Dang in 2017. (Source: Lang Son Water Supply and Drainage Joint Stock Company). Data Source: Provincial water supply company reports and project completion report Baseline value: 0

New universities and residential areas served by new road in Hung Yen Progress/Status: Residential areas and new university are served by the new roads. Data Source: City annual reports and project completion report Baseline value: N

Passengers at the Huu Nghi border gate increased from 710,606 (2010) to 1.1 million (2016) Progress/Status: In 2016, the number of visitors through Huu Nghi Border Gate is 1.0 million people. (Source: Dong Dang-Lang Son Border Gate Economic Zone). Data Source: Border gate economic zone PMU reports, Customs reports, and project completion report. Baseline value: 710606

Road congestion along National Road 2 reduced from 6,000 automobiles (2010) to 5,000 (2016) per day in each direction in Viet Tri by diverting the traffic to the city ring road Progress/Status: The density of vehicles along Highway 2 is 4,221 cars (June 2017) one way per day in Viet Tri as moving the traffic flow to the city ring roads. (Source: the Department of Transport of Phu Tho Province). Data Source: City annual reports and project completion report Baseline value: 6000

Solid waste collection increased from 120 tons/day (2010) to 150 tons/day (2016) in Viet Tri Progress/Status: December 2015, the amount of solid waste collected in the city of Viet Tri reached 145 tons/ day (Source: the Viet Tri Environment and Service JSC.) Data Source: URENCO reports and project completion report Baseline value: 120

Time required for custom clearance for goods at the Huu Nghi border gate reduced from 5 hours (2010) to 2 hours (2016) Progress/Status: December 2016, the time required for customs clearance of goods at Huu Nghi Border Gate is 3 hours. (Source: Dong Dang-Lang Son Border Gate Economic Zone). Data Source: Border gate economic zone PMU reports, customs reports, and project completion report Baseline value: 5

Tourist arrivals increased from 134,658 (2009) to 200,000 (2016) in Hung Yen province Progress/Status: In 2016, the number of tourists arriving to Hung Yen province is 420,000 people. (Source: the Hung Yen Provincial Tourism Master Plan Development Report 2025 with vision to 2030). Data Source: City annual reports and project completion report Baseline value: 134658

Trade at the Huu Nghi border gate increased from $859 million (2010) to $1.7 billion (2016) Progress/Status: Trade at Huu Nghi Border Gate was $ 2.1 billion in 2016. (Source: Dong Dang-Lang Son Border Gate Economic Zone). Data Source: Border gate economic zone PMU reports, Customs reports, and project completion report. Baseline value: 859

Travel distance from Noi Bai-Lao Cai expressway to the city center through Phu Dong road reduced from 5.5 km (2010) to 4.1 km (2016) in Viet Tri Progress/Status: Distance from the Noi Bai-Lao Cai Express highway to the city center reduced from 5.5 kms in 2010 to 4.1 kms in 2017 with the completion of Phu Dong road. Data Source: City annual reports and project completion report Baseline value: 5.5
